changes: Initial model version. Five scenarios (S1 ransomware/destructive extortion, S2 identity/phishing/social engineering, S3 public-facing vulnerability exploitation, S4 third-party/supplier compromise, S5 DDoS/service disruption).
Eight organisation-profile questions, of which QP1-QP7 are required and QP8 (daily disruption cost) is optional but strongly recommended.
Triangular distributions for frequency, susceptibility, loss magnitude and secondary-loss magnitude; Bernoulli draw for secondary-loss occurrence.
Frequency bands and impact multipliers taken from requirements v2 section 12 illustrative mappings and retained as the v1 calibration basis.
Secondary-loss probability and magnitude are scenario-specific and are modified by sensitive-information exposure (and, for S4, third-party dependency).
Confidence scoring based on unknown answers, availability of the disruption-cost anchor, distribution width and calibration status.
calibrationChangePolicy: Calibration values are changed only by publishing a new calibration version and a new model version record. The meaning of an existing version is never edited in place. Because no user assessment is retained, calibration changes cannot retroactively alter any prior assessment.
knownLimitations: Calibration values are application assumptions/heuristics, not universally authoritative FAIR values.
All parameters are classified as internally-derived or heuristic in this release; none are externally evidenced coefficients.
Scenario correlation is not modelled, so no joint portfolio percentile is produced.
Loss magnitude is sampled once per simulated year rather than once per event.
Statutory fines and legal liabilities are explicitly out of scope.
